mismatch.consequence: V1 is materially undertrained relative to the recipe it claims to reproduce; failed quality does not establish a dataset ceiling.
mismatch.primaryRootCause: V1 copied upstream iteration count and batch size but not the 200-frame sequence semantics or dataset-loop meaning.
mismatch.secondaryRisk: single-frame uniform sampling can be silence-dominated because silence is accepted as a valid training target.

outputContract.notes: Pinned GuitarProfile adds one open-string pitch to num_frets, and TabCNN adds one silence class.

pinnedUpstreamSemantics.datasetItemMeaning: one random contiguous 200-frame slice from a track
pinnedUpstreamSemantics.globalIterationMeaning: one complete loop over train_loader, not one optimizer step
pinnedUpstreamSemantics.trackSamplingPerGlobalIteration: each dataset track is indexed once before DataLoader batching (subject to drop_last in the published experiment)

v1TrainingSemantics.sampling: performance-group-with-replacement -> capture-view-with-replacement -> one uniformly random frame
v1TrainingSemantics.silenceAcceptanceEvidence: sample_batch rejects only MASK=-100; ordinary silence=-1 satisfies y != MASK

v2DesignConstraints.captureViewSelection: deterministic rotation among alignment-accepted views within each underlying performance
v2DesignConstraints.loss: all unmasked string labels across all 200 sequence frames
v2DesignConstraints.segmentStart: deterministic seeded random contiguous 200-frame slice within selected view
